name: Fur Weave
//: Explicitly not skin or armor subtype to maintain the other properties and visuals of the fur this mutation developed on to. No visibility or ugliness either, the fur it builds off of looks normal from surface.
description: The fur closest to your skin has grown into a complex weave, similar to ballistic kevlar.

name: Tail Launcher
//: give this thing an integrated pocket or something, and have the launcher draw ammo from it like a quiver?
description: An openable orifice that can retract a stinger now lies in your tail, along with an organ capable of launching the stinger at velocities comparable to a powerful bow.

ranged_mutation.message: You launch your stinger at the %.
